Magpie

dataset.magpie

Prepared 15 Nov 2026 · Evidence snapshot 12 Nov 2026 · Report research-2026-11-12.1 · Evidence research-2026-11-11.candidate.1

Evidence & scope

Creator-maintained documentation received separate bounded AI source-content reviews of construction, human/model roles, formats, licensing/access statements and limitations. Exact source revisions remain bound to every observation. Per-role full/partial/unread scopes differ and are recorded separately. This is no corpus download/recount, verification of every data file, model evaluation or assurance that another release shares these properties.

Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

Magpie · generated: Magpie generates queries and responses from aligned LLM pre-query templates without seed questions.

Permanent record ID: candidate.cohort3.dataset.magpie.01

  • First-party creator-document statement, not an independent corpus audit.
  • Reviewed scope: Pinned release card plus pinned official magpie-align/magpie README and code license. Card-specific claims are limited to Llama-3 70B Pro filtered data.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

Magpie · licenses: At the pinned versions, the official Magpie repository README displays a CC BY NC 4.0 data badge and a MIT code badge; the Magpie-Pro-300K-Filtered card declares llama3, while the repository LICENSE declares MIT for software.

Permanent record ID: repair.qualification.v1.claim.magpie.source-specific-license-labels

  • These are separate, version-specific first-party declarations. Their different labels are retained without harmonizing them into one governing dataset license.
  • Release-card findings concern only Magpie-Pro-300K-Filtered at revision523df96eb7474e97bca6f378b3baa372a4735fcc; repository findings concern commit b734a36818e4ba7ef7f0f582fc55f7e860407d26. No corpus-byte rights audit or general permission for other Magpie releases is established.
  • The repository software LICENSE and README badges are not substituted for a release-specific dataset legal instrument.
